The solution to the system of equations shown is (x, y).

y = 2x - 7
y = -5x

What is the y-coordinate of the solution to the system of equations shown?
problem.stimulus:
The solution to the system of equations shown is (x, y).

y = 2x - 7
y = -5x
problem.question: What is the y-coordinate of the solution to the system of equations shown?
problem.explanation: 두 식의 우변이 같으므로 2x - 7 = -5x이다. 양변에서 정리하면 (7)x = 7이므로 x = 7 ÷ (7) = 1이다. 이를 y = 2x - 7에 대입하면 y = 2 × 1 - 7 = -5이다. 따라서 y좌표는 -5이다.
problem.explanationEn: Since the right-hand sides are equal, 2x - 7 = -5x. Rearranging gives (7)x = 7, so x = 7 ÷ (7) = 1. Substituting into y = 2x - 7 gives y = 2 × 1 - 7 = -5. So the y-coordinate is -5.
